title: Document default_kind and kinds.<kind>.prompt in the grading schema
item: Add the two grading.json fields task 028 introduced, default_kind (the kind /trial runs) and kinds.<kind>.prompt (its run prompt, PROMPT.md when absent), and the RETIRED description prefix, to skill-iterate/references/grading-schema.md
motivation: /trial and /iterate now read these fields, but the schema reference, which /setup-eval follows, does not describe them; it is protected, so task 028 could not
notes: Found while building task 028. 2026-11-15, owner: folded into task 28's done_means.
done_means: grading-schema.md describes default_kind, kinds.<kind>.prompt and the RETIRED prefix as commands/trial.md uses them.
draft_note: Drafted by the task-028 builder. Owner fields are a proposal; priority left for the owner.
